span.p:
TimeManager runs parallel:
OPENING (0-25%) → light pace
MIDDLE (25-75%) → main depth
CLOSING (75-100%) → wrap up signals
Callbacks fire at phase boundaries
+ halfway + 5-min warning

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SessionGuard (background asyncio task)
fires independently if:
wall_clock ≥ 1800s (30 min)
OR turn_count ≥ 60
Sends WebSocket INTERVIEW_ENDED
regardless of frontend state
